webhook.dialogDescription: Every webhook delivery is signed so receivers can make sure it is genuine and unaltered.
webhook.title: HMAC-SHA256 signature
webhook.intro: The platform POSTs application/json to your URL with the headers below. Refuse requests whose signature does not match or whose timestamp is stale.

headers.signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret of the key, "<timestamp>.<raw body>")>.
headers.delivery: Delivery id — use it to ignore retries of the same delivery.
headers.keyId: The key that signed: the channel's keyId (UUID), deployment (a channel from before version 0.2.0) or test (a test notification to another target).

steps.raw: Read the raw body exactly as received, before parsing JSON.
steps.hmac: Pick the secret by X-AIS-ITS-Key-Id, then compute HMAC-SHA256 over "<timestamp>.<raw body>".
steps.compare: Compare it with X-AIS-ITS-Signature in constant time.
steps.fresh: Refuse timestamps more than 5 minutes away from your server clock.
steps.dedupe: Answer 2xx quickly; 408, 429, 5xx and timeouts are retried, any other status fails for good.

webhook.secretText: Every webhook channel has its own secret (whsec_…), shown only once: when the channel is created or when its secret is rotated (the rule's actions menu). Channels from before version 0.2.0 are signed with the deployment secret (key id deployment) until their secret is rotated.
